errorCodes.meaning: A layer of the relay does not hold: a relay's or the notification's proof does not verify, a forwarded document is not addressed to the issuer of the relay carrying it, the innermost document is not a notification, the notification may not be relayed, or the relay carries more than four relays in all.

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

ForwardedDocument.description: The Trust Task document the relayer received, kept whole and exactly as received — proof included — never restated, re-serialised from a typed form, or re-signed: a notifications/notify/0.1 document, or a notifications/relay/0.1 document whose own `forwarded` carries the next layer in. Deliberately an opaque object, so that every member the originator signed — `issuedAt`, `expiresAt`, `threadId` and any other envelope member — survives every relay byte for byte. Its `recipient` MUST be this relay's `issuer`, because only the addressee of a notification may relay it (VTI-NTF-041). The recipient validates each layer as a document of its own `type`, to at most four relays in all (VTI-NTF-042).
ForwardedDocument.title: ForwardedDocument

NotificationId.description: The originator's identifier for one notification, unique among the notifications that originator issues and the same in every document that carries it — retries, re-issued documents and relayed copies alike. It is the notification's idempotency key (VTI-NTF-021). Compared for equality only. An originator SHOULD make it unguessable and SHOULD NOT make it descriptive: it travels as far as the notification does.
NotificationId.title: NotificationId

Response.description: Receipt of a relay the recipient verified, naming the innermost notification. The same whether the recipient held it, declined it under its acceptance policy, or relayed it on, and never saying which (VTI-NTF-023).

revision.description: The revision of the innermost notification, echoed.

Response.title: Notifications — Relay — response payload

schema.description: A party that stands for others — a group, a community, a network — passes a notification it was addressed to on to one of them, carrying the document it received exactly as received, proof included, so the final recipient verifies the originator's own signature. The outer document members (id, type, issuer, recipient, issuedAt, expiresAt, proof) are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.
schema.title: Notifications — Relay — payload
